# Review Before Rollout

## Caption

Agent tools should not become team-installable just because someone copied a config. Intertool adds a review path: submit, inspect, approve, and distribute with a clean audit trail.

#AIGovernance #EngineeringLeadership #PlatformEngineering #DeveloperExperience #AgenticAI #Intertool

## Alt Text

1. Agent capabilities deserve code-review energy. If a capability can shape output, it needs review before rollout.
2. Submit the capability. A skill, MCP server, prompt, or tool enters the review queue.
3. Inspect risk and intent. Reviewers see metadata, package files, source context, and install behavior.
4. Approve, reject, or archive. Status becomes explicit instead of living in a chat thread.
5. Publish the approved install command. Developers get a clean path to the exact capability version.
6. Turn agent rollout into a governed workflow. Use Intertool to make approval visible, repeatable, and auditable.
